answer:
**TX-0401 is confirmed:** EUR 240.00, outgoing card payment to **TechMart Online** on 2026-07-20, status settled.

I noticed **TX-0402** is also EUR 240.00 to TechMart Online, dated 2026-07-14 and settled. I'm only pointing out that the two match; I haven't assessed whether either one is a problem.

Reason codes that could apply to a card payment like this:

| Reason code | What it covers | Dispute window (days from transaction date) |
|---|---|---|
| duplicate_charge | The same purchase was charged more than once | 60 |
| unauthorized_debit | You did not authorise the payment | 56 |
| fraud_card_not_present | Card details were used fraudulently in an online or phone transaction | 120 |
| goods_not_received | You paid but did not receive the goods | 90 |
| service_not_rendered | You paid but the service was not provided (evidence: the booking or contract and the date the service was due) | 90 |

Which of these fits depends on what happened. Tell me, and I'll check eligibility for the relevant code before anything is opened. Nothing has been filed.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Reason code guide
## service_not_rendered
Used when a paid-for service was not provided. Evidence: the booking or
contract and the date the service was due.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.
